def factor_intraday_volume_tanh(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    open_ = df_copy["open"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    w = 20
    intra_ret = close / open_.replace(0, np.nan) - 1
    vol_sma = volume.rolling(w, min_periods=w).mean()
    vol_surge = volume / vol_sma.replace(0, np.nan)
    raw = intra_ret * vol_surge
    factor = raw.ewm(span=w, adjust=False).mean()
    factor = np.tanh(factor)
    df_copy["factor_intraday_volume_tanh"] = factor.fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_intraday_volume_tanh"]
description: Borrows primary mechanism from MUT_AVR_001 (intraday return scaled by volume surge, smoothed by EWMA) and replaces hard clipping with tanh compression from alpha-crossover-0-1 to softly bound extremes while preserving directional signal. Targets improving IC (from 0.0253) toward the stronger IC of alpha-crossover-0-1 (0.0356) without degrading the rank stability (RankIC 0.043, RankICIR 0.371) of MUT_AVR_001.
